metadata.description: Official BugMojo plugins for Claude Code — bugs with real browser evidence, versioned test plans, and recorded test runs over MCP.

plugins.name: bugmojo
plugins.description: Plan, generate, run and prove your tests. Interviews you into a versioned test plan, proposes cases into a review queue with an automatable-vs-manual verdict, writes Playwright specs verified against the running app, records every run with trace/video evidence, and turns a failure into a bug with an executable repro.
